run_posetrack18_baseline_training: run the posetrack18 baseline training script using hrnet w48 384x288 config with a pretrained COCO model
run_posetrack18_baseline_inference: run the posetrack18 baseline inference using the trained model and precomputed bounding boxes on the val set
run_posetrack18_posewarper_training: run the posewarper training script fine-tuned from the baseline model with 19 epochs on posetrack18 data
run_posetrack18_temporal_pose_aggregatio: run the temporal pose aggregation inference via posewarper using the trained posewarper model on the val set
review_posetrack18_helper_script: review the posetrack18_helper script that orchestrates baseline and posewarper training and inference experiments
